I am 56 years old, almost 57. I've tried pretty much every under eye dark circle cream out there for the last 30+ years. I recently started using Kiehl's Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado, and I am thoroughly impressed with the results. The texture is rich and creamy, yet it absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue. I appreciate how it provides intense hydration, which has noticeably reduced the dryness and puffiness around my eyes. The natural ingredients, particularly the avocado oil, make it feel nourishing and gentle on my skin. After just a few weeks of use, my under-eye area looks brighter and feels smoother. I highly recommend this product for anyone looking for an effective, moisturizing eye cream.

Pros: does not migrate or burn eyes overnight which is GREAT since they promote this, little goes a long way, thicker in tub than under eyes (taps/glides on lightly), hydrating but not sticky or oily. Take it or leave it: I've had it for 5 months and I've NOT experienced the separation others speak of. Again, I have a mini-size that's well-loved, so YMMV with the full-size or with longer periods of time. Cons: No significant difference in brightness or fine lines. YMMV, as I am 33 with dark circles and newly formed fine lines in outer corners, mostly related to squinting migraines) I received a sample size for free that I've been using for months before deciding to review. Overall Kiehl's products typically agree with my skin and this was no different. I would purchase since it lives up to the non-migrating claim, which is important to me and my sensitive eyes.

i picked this up at an airport Kiehl's when I realized I didn't pack eye cream. It was pricey, but they had a travel size, which fit my need. I loved how creamy the texture was, and it felt great on my skin. I used it for my trip, but then went back to my regular eye cream when I went home. A few weeks later, I had a horrible allergy attack (worst pollen day ever) and the skin around my eyes were puffy like I had been crying for days and very dry. I needed to meet my friend for dress shopping and i looked atrocious. I remembered how gentle the Kiehls eye cream was, so I unpacked it and out some on to help with the dryness. I went on my way, and didn't think about my eyes again until an hour later I looked in the mirror, and the puffiness was completely gone. I was amazed. Usually some puffiness would go away on its own, but all of it was gone and my eyes looked great! This is now part of my daily regime!

avis.titre: The Eye Cream That Delivers The Sleep You Didn't Get
avis.texte: If you're like me and tired of looking like a raccoon that hasn't slept since the Bush administration, Kiehl's Since 1851 Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado is the miracle you've been waiting for. You can't just guacamole your way to less eye baggage, but this little jar of heaven comes close. The texture is creamy and luxurious, gliding on smoothly without leaving a greasy aftermath. Best of all, you can actually see it working—hydrating and brightening your under-eye area in a way those overpriced concoctions never do. Yes, it's not a dollar store find, but consider it an investment in not looking like you live under a bridge. A little dab goes a long way, so this jar will last you a good while. With nourishing ingredients like avocado oil, beta-carotene, and shea butter, it's like a smoothie for your face—nourishing, natural, and free of weird chemicals. In my opinion, Kiehl's Creamy Eye Treatment with Avocado is like a tiny jar of "Oh, I slept a full eight hours" in a world where nobody actually does. Say goodbye to dark circles and fine lines with this easy solution.

This eye cream has truly captured my heart and earned a cherished spot in my top 3 favorites! It's like a dream come true, meeting every expectation I have: no annoying bumps, incredible moisture, and zero burning sensations. The texture is pure bliss, leaving my delicate eye area looking radiant and deeply nourished. As someone who relies on contacts and eye drops, I've been let down by other creams that smudge and sting, but not this gem. It effortlessly melds into my skin, embracing it with its gentle yet effective formula. I can't help but sing praises for its clean ingredients, a refreshing oasis in a sea of skincare products. While the packaging may not be the flashiest, its practicality shines through, especially during my travels. And let's talk about its compatibility with makeup – it's like they were made for each other, creating a flawless canvas for my daily glam. Yes, it's true that the price tag is a tad higher, but trust me, every penny is worth it. The quality speaks volumes, and a little goes a long way, making it an investment that keeps on giving. Even though I was fortunate enough to receive this product as a gift for review, I am wholeheartedly committed to repurchasing it when my supply runs low. That's how much I adore it!
I love using this product- the texture is so cool and feels very moisturizing. It also sinks in really fast and doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes.

avis.titre: Highly moisturizing, no lasting brightening effect
avis.texte: I received this product for free from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this avocado cream for several weeks in addition to my existing skincare routine. The best thing about this product is that it has reduced the appearance of the fine lines around my eyes. It moisturizes very well, but I don't believe the product had much of a brightening effect for me. Frankly, I think the green color of the cream is probably what Kiehl's is referring to when they claim "this brightening eye cream immediately improves the look [...]". The green of the cream is simply optically dampening the blues, purples, and red spots around my eyes with no real lasting brightening effects. The texture of this cream is enjoyable to me and seems appropriate for an overnight cream. It's a bit tacky and can feel a little oily/greasy upon application, but it does soak in well and doesn't feel oily in the morning. Another bonus is that the improved hydration of the skin around my eyes makes has improved the application and longevity of eye makeup application. Overall, the product is decent and at a fair price point, but since the results didn't "wow" me I likely would not purchase this for myself.

Kiehl's Creamy Avocado Eye Cream is a true skincare classic, and probably the very first eye cream I ever tried many moons ago. I love how thick in consistency it is and how incredibly hydrated it makes the skin under eyes my eyes feel. My favorite thing about this eye cream though is how it does not budge. No red eyes, no waking up with my eyes watering or stinging, no migrating to your eyes when you are sleeping.
